artifact: F-5.2A final summary (zero-cost forensics + architecture proof over the frozen F-5.1 paid pair)
verdictBasis: the F-5.2 hypothesis is PROVEN on the frozen pair (every one of the 50 omissions is a proposition the missing run folded into a coarser item shared by both runs (34) or left unaccounted after the gap pass (16); 0 partition or post-processing failures), but the generic source-form obligation ledger does NOT expose those omissions consistently: it reaches 28/50 conservatively (16 through a real feature anchor, 12 only through the whole-slot BASE anchor that raw coverage already exposes) and 30/50 with fine coordination splits, against the pre-registered 0.67, while creating 172 (53%) / 384 (61%) candidate false obligations that BOTH independent runs treated as parts of larger propositions, against the pre-registered 0.30. Generic source form neither predicts nor bounds the number of independent propositions in a slot; making it finer trades a few more captures for far more review noise. Nothing was wired into production.
providerAccess: none (no key read, no gateway request, no model invocation)

F.emittedIn: not recoverable per item from the frozen inventory (no per-item pass flag); the failure stage is determined from the MISSING run's deterministic coverage instead

forensics.sameRootAsF: 8 of 12 B and 6 of 6 H are the same mechanism (the other run holds the text inside a coarser or differently bounded item); 4 B are boundary-only splits

hypothesis.artifact: F-5.2A hypothesis test: deterministic slots fix where the model looks, the model still decides how many propositions each slot holds

falseSatisfactionCandidates.definition: satisfied only by inside-coverage (rule b) with no anchored item; listed for audit, counted as satisfied

required.slotsPopulatedByBothRunsWithDifferentIte: > 0 and accounts for the F cases

genericRules.evidence: kinds = BASE_SLOT, ENUMERATED_BRANCH, COORDINATED_FRAGMENT, QUANTITATIVE_SPAN, EXPLICIT_REFERENCE, QUALIFIER_OR_PROVISO, EXCEPTION_FRAGMENT, SELECTOR_BRANCH, ARITHMETIC_OPERAND, TEMPORAL_SPAN; recognisers are enumerators, semicolons/comma-coordination, citation form, scanner values, qualifier/exception openers, selector phrases, arithmetic operators; no Chewy / 6.08 / EBITDA / basket vocabulary (grep-verified)

deterministicIdentity.idInputs: documentId, regionId, slotId, charStart, charEnd, kind, ordinal, algorithm version

trust.evidence: design only creates review work: unsatisfied obligation => INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP; raw coverage untouched; nothing was wired into production, so no trust surface changed

whyGenericObligationsFail: 16 of the 50 omitted spans start at no generic feature boundary at all (mid-clause coordinations without a comma, defined-term parentheticals, verb-phrase continuations) - no rule short of splitting on every conjunction anchors them, and that rule doubles the ledger and the false-obligation count

6 omitted spans ARE anchored by an obligation that the missing run nevertheless satisfies, because its coarser item starts at the same place - the model's item boundary, not the source, decided the proposition count

12 captures come only from the BASE_SLOT anchor on whole-slot continuation fragments, which raw source coverage already surfaced as UNACCOUNTED and the gap pass already re-presented (the gap model omitted them anyway: GAP_MODEL_OMISSION 16) - an obligation adds a stable target id, not new exposure

197 obligations (conservative) are unsatisfied in BOTH runs and 172 of them sit inside larger items in both runs: two independent inventories agree those fragments are not separate propositions, so the ledger would generate ~200 review items per unit that are mostly not omissions

notImplemented.production: no file under lib/ changed; the generator + resolver used for the experiment live in scripts/f5-2a-obligations-experiment.ts
notImplemented.syntheticTests: not applicable - the layer is not implemented (mission section 12: STOP)
notImplemented.sameRootReplay: not applicable (no mapper in production); the counterfactual on the frozen pair is the only replay

recommendation: the residual F-5 variance is the model's per-slot proposition count; a source-form ledger cannot fix it. Candidates for a future mission (not started here): (a) a model-side self-consistency step per slot (two independent slot inventories reconciled by the deterministic identity, at ~2x Pass A cost), or (b) treating the union of two runs' propositions as the inventory with per-item run provenance, so omission becomes disclosed asymmetry rather than silent absence.
